AuditLog._: Enter the desired path for the audit log file. Leave empty to create it in the current working directory.

AdminConnectionStrings._: Add your connection strings here. You can toggle which one is used by the command line argument '-n|--connection-string-name'.

DatabaseSetup._: Parameters used to create a missing database

DatabaseSchemaSetupCombinations._: Hashmap containing the key-value pairs of the form 'database-name': 'schema-name'.

UserSetupTemplates._: If you want to use a single app and readonly user for all schemas within the same database, set this to true.

Owner._: Provide a template for the user that will be the owner of all created objects
Owner.__: Provide a custom password or leave the field empty to generate a random password

UserSetupTemplates.__: You can provide multiple AppUser entries. This might be useful if you want to track connections from different machines.

AppUsers._: Provide a template for the user that will have read write permissions on all created objects
AppUsers.__: Provide a custom password or leave the field empty to generate a random password

UserSetupTemplates.___: You can provide multiple ReadOnlyUser entries. This might be useful if you want to track connections from different machines.

ReadOnlyUser._: Provide a template for the user that will, as the name implies, only have read permissions on all created objects
ReadOnlyUser.__: Provide a custom password or leave the field empty to generate a random password
